about: The folder search's evaluation set (phase 5, her task: '15 to 20 question, answer and source triples drawn from the fixture corpus'). Each item is one of rag/fixtures/FACTS.json, chosen to cover the seven file types, the three folders and the 4 MB logbook (H09). A retrieval finds an item when one of its five passages is from the source file (file level, her criterion) and, stricter, when that passage holds the needle. household_papers is the restricted folder: the second user, test-b, may not read it.
